node.statement: Stage-3 raw-call packaging and conclusion. Record the literal call-type as Stage 3; the two supplied reset states as inputs; source B_U direct-sum B_V; target A_R; pre-helper base scale t; post-helper datum scale rho=C_cross*t; the four corner maps of node 1.7 (equivalently their assembled level-one map gamma(b_U,b_V)=T_U(b_U)+T_V(b_V), since the source cross-corners vanish) and the fixed family I_n tensor gamma; target ambient defect epsilon_R=2*C_ca*t; and recorded raw defect d_raw=rho. These are precisely the fields required by def-maincb-raw-call, which deliberately asserts no later merge success. Nodes 1.3--1.7 prove that the recorded post-helper object is the explicit amplified four-corner datum required by this raw call, and node 1.1 gives rho<=C_cross*t with universal C_cross>=1 and e_cross>0. This proves the root contract.
